scripts.postbuild:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('out/admin/index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('out/admin/index.html','out/admin.html'); if(fs.existsSync('out/admin/login/index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('out/admin/login/index.html','out/admin/login.html'); const ht='DirectoryIndex index.html
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1.html [L]
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/$1/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.*)/?$ $1/index.html [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/api [NC]
RewriteRule ^ index.html [L]
</IfModule>
'; fs.writeFileSync('out/.htaccess', ht);"
